description.value: The Black Forest Restaurant is a long-established fine dining destination on Highway 93/95 at the entrance to Invermere, serving authentic Bavarian and European cuisine since the late 1970s. It is best known for its house-made schnitzels in multiple preparations, alongside steak, seafood, duck, lamb, and homemade desserts, all accompanied by an extensive beer and wine list. Situated in the Windermere Valley just 1.5 hours west of Banff, it makes a compelling dinner stop for cyclists touring the Kootenay National Park corridor.
